## Goal

Score an object from its size, how long its owning project has been idle, its rebuild cost and its risk class, using project activity rather than the directory's own timestamp, and state the rebuild command for each known object kind.

## Deliverables

- Reclaim ranking with stated inputs
- Rebuild command catalogue
